import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

def zscore_detection(data, threshold=3.0):
    """Detect outliers using standard Z-score method."""
    z_scores = np.abs(stats.zscore(data))
    outliers = data[z_scores > threshold]
    return z_scores, outliers

def modified_zscore_detection(data, threshold=3.5):
    """Detect outliers using modified Z-score (robust to outliers)."""
    median = np.median(data)
    mad = np.median(np.abs(data - median))
    modified_z = 0.6745 * (data - median) / mad
    outliers = data[np.abs(modified_z) > threshold]
    return modified_z, outliers

# Create dataset with outliers
np.random.seed(42)
normal_data = np.random.normal(50, 10, 100)
outlier_values = np.array([5, -20, 120, 150, -30])
data = np.concatenate([normal_data, outlier_values])

# Standard Z-score
z_scores, std_outliers = zscore_detection(data, threshold=3.0)
print("Standard Z-Score Detection:")
print(f"  Threshold: 3.0")
print(f"  Outliers found: {len(std_outliers)}")
print(f"  Outlier values: {np.round(std_outliers, 1)}")

# Modified Z-score
mod_z, mod_outliers = modified_zscore_detection(data, threshold=3.5)
print("\nModified Z-Score Detection:")
print(f"  Threshold: 3.5")
print(f"  Outliers found: {len(mod_outliers)}")
print(f"  Outlier values: {np.round(mod_outliers, 1)}")

# Comparison
print(f"\nMean: {np.mean(data):.2f}, Median: {np.median(data):.2f}")
print(f"Std: {np.std(data):.2f}, MAD: {np.median(np.abs(data - np.median(data))):.2f}")
